title: Relaxed measurement criterion for good serving cell quality

entities.name: RLM good serving cell quality criterion
entities.description: Relaxed measurement criterion for Radio Link Monitoring that starts evaluation after configuration reception and is fulfilled when downlink radio link quality on RLM-RS resource is better than threshold Q + XdB.

entities.name: BFD good serving cell quality criterion
entities.description: Relaxed measurement criterion for Beam Failure Detection that starts evaluation after configuration reception and is fulfilled when downlink radio link quality on BFD-RS resource is better than threshold Q + XdB.

entities.name: Good serving cell quality criterion configuration
entities.description: Configuration that triggers the start of evaluation for relaxed measurement criteria for both RLM and BFD.

entities.name: offset in goodServingCellEvaluationRLM
entities.description: Parameter X used in RLM good serving cell quality criterion calculation as offset to threshold Q.

entities.name: offset in goodServingCellEvaluationBFD
entities.description: Parameter X used in BFD good serving cell quality criterion calculation as offset to threshold Q.

entities.name: Threshold Q
entities.description: Base threshold specified in TS 38.133 clause 8.1 used for good serving cell quality evaluation.

relations.description: Receiving the good serving cell quality criterion configuration starts the evaluation of RLM relaxed measurement criterion.
Receiving the good serving cell quality criterion configuration starts the evaluation of BFD relaxed measurement criterion.
RLM criterion fulfillment is determined by comparing radio link quality to threshold Q plus the offset parameter from goodServingCellEvaluationRLM.
BFD criterion fulfillment is determined by comparing radio link quality to threshold Q plus the offset parameter from goodServingCellEvaluationBFD.
RLM criterion uses threshold Q from TS 38.133 as base for quality comparison.
BFD criterion uses threshold Q from TS 38.133 as base for quality comparison.
